breadcrumbs.name: NFC Warranty Seal Tags — Digital Tamper Detection & Cryptographic Authentication For Product Packaging

summary: NFC warranty seal tags combine a destructible adhesive label with an NTAG424 DNA chip to create a tamper-evident seal for product packaging, electronics enclosures and warranty-protected equipment. If the seal is broken, the NFC chip permanently records the tamper event — providing digital proof of unauthorized opening.
